summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Settings sections: Users, Roles, Automations, and Integrations. All 19 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI components and interactions verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test created invited users, custom roles, and automations during testing (prefixed with TEST_ or unique UUIDs)
context_for_next_testing_agent: New Settings sections fully functional. Default roles (Admin, Finance, Operations) and default automations (Payment Reminder, Low Stock Alert, Event Reminder) are created on first access. Stripe is pre-configured as connected integration.

details: Settings page has new tabs: Branding, Users, Roles, Automations, Integrations, Features, Lead Forms, Categories, Picklist, Taxes, Templates, Preferences
All tabs are clickable and load their respective sections

api_endpoints.GET /api/settings/users: Returns list of company users (password_hash excluded)
api_endpoints.POST /api/settings/users/invite: Creates invited user with role assignment
api_endpoints.PUT /api/settings/users/{user_id}: Updates user name, role, and active status

ui_features: Users table with User, Email, Role, Status columns
Invite User button opens dialog with Name, Email, Role fields
Edit and Deactivate buttons per user row

api_endpoints.GET /api/settings/roles: Returns list of roles (creates defaults if none exist)

ui_features: Role cards showing name, description, and permission badges
System roles (Admin, Finance, Operations) marked with lock icon
New Role button opens dialog with Name (EN/ES), Description, and Permissions checkboxes
Permissions grouped by module: Events, CRM, Culinary, Finance, Settings
Select all option per permission group

api_endpoints.GET /api/settings/automations: Returns list of automations (creates defaults if none exist)

ui_features: Automation cards with icon, name, description, status badge
Channel badges (email, in_app) and config badges (days before/overdue)
New Automation button opens dialog with Name, Trigger Type, Notification Channels
Trigger types: Payment Reminder, Low Stock Alert, Event Reminder, Task Due Date, New Lead

api_endpoints.GET /api/settings/integrations: Returns list of integrations (Stripe always included)

ui_features: Integration cards with icon, name, description, status badge
Category filter buttons: All, Accounting, Communication, Payments
Available integrations: Alegra, QuickBooks, Gmail, WhatsApp, Stripe
Stripe marked as pre-configured by system

code_review_notes.server.py: New endpoints properly implemented with authentication, company isolation, and proper error handling
code_review_notes.UsersSettingsSection.js: Clean implementation with search, table, and dialog components
code_review_notes.RolesSettingsSection.js: Well-structured with permission groups and system role protection
code_review_notes.AutomationsSettingsSection.js: Good UX with toggle switches and channel selection
code_review_notes.IntegrationsSettingsSection.js: Category filtering and OAuth support placeholder implemented
